Mod.Name: Symphonic Remasters: Redux
Mod.Description: Complete FF7 soundtrack replacement in a symphonic style. Thanks to Bonez for the artwork and Satsuki for video upscales! To hear the included intro/ending movies, place this mod above other movie mods. If other music mods include movies, disable the movies from the other mods if possible.
